picks.headline: Starform's Lou Fasulo on staying at 26 people, AI-native development and who really funds a live game
picks.excerpt: The Metalstorm studio head says AI gave his 26-person team more throughput, not new capability, and explains where AI-native development stops.
picks.rationale: Most AI-substantive item left in the recovery pool: a studio head describes where AI-native production helps a 26-person live-game team and where it stops. It is a new outlet for today's set and not a duplicate. The earlier PocketGamer.biz Nordic AI-native piece from 08-26 covers different studios.
